criteria.b_estimator: frame-averaged (self-similar) wall-pressure profile binned in tau = |x|/(C V t), 3-bin moving average inside the band; peak = largest value on |x| <= tau_r c, tau_r = 1 - 3 dx/c
criteria.b_metric: mean over resolved frames of |max_SPH - max_Wagner| / max_Wagner on the common band |x| <= (1 - 3dx/c) c, both maxima taken on the same bin centres of tau = |x|/(C V t)
